name: BBP simulation campaign analysis - whisker deflections scan
description: This notebook loads and analyzes a simulation campaign recorded at the Blue Brain Project (BBP) using the nbS1-O1-SM (Schneider-Mizell) circuit. The campaign consists of 72 simulations with whisker flick stimulation on VPM fibers, scanned over different values of calcium, Ornstein-Uhlenbeck std to mean ratio R_OU, in-vivo firing rate proportion P_FR, and percentage of VPM fibers. Related publication: Isbister et al., 2025 (DOI: 10.7554/eLife.99693.2)
